subject: Retention carve-out & emergency purge SOP for HealthBridge backups
messages:
From: Sara Alvarez <sara@healthbridge.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: carve-out for emergency restore + purge SOP

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — HealthBridge is close to a procurement decision, but we have one gating ask from compliance. We need a documented SOP that allows us to: 
- keep a small subset of customer backups for 90 days beyond default retention in case of legal e-discovery, and
- have a clearly defined emergency purge process if a customer requests deletion with a verified evidentiary hold lift.

Two constraints: we cannot accept copies leaving the EU for longer than 24 hours without a transfer justification, and we need SOC2 evidence that the carve-out is logged and auditable. Can Redwood propose a safe, auditable approach (timeline + guardrails)?

Appreciate quick turnaround — procurement would like this baked into the DPA amendment.

Best,
Sara
Sara Alvarez
Director of Security & Compliance, HealthBridge
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Sara Alvarez <sara@healthbridge.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Apr 2028 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: carve-out for emergency restore + purge SOP

Hi Sara — looping in Kimberley and Karthik from Privacy & Ops. Attached is a first-draft SOP and a suggested timeline spreadsheet (backup_timeline.xlsx). High-level proposal:

• Soft-retention carve-out: isolated snapshots flagged as "evidence_hold" that remain immutable for up to 90 days. These snapshots are read-only and accessible only to a named ops role.

• Emergency purge flow: when a verified deletion request is received and the hold is lifted, we perform a two-step purge (metadata erase + crypto key shred) with an audit record.

• Cross-border restriction: any EU-scoped snapshots must remain in EU-backed storage. For temporary processing we support a 24-hour transit window with documented justification — otherwise the snapshot stays in-region.

Kimberly — can you confirm the legal wording we'd need in the DPA amendment? Karthik — can you confirm feasibility and any runtime caveats (KV cache, snapshot dependencies)?

Next steps: Kimberley to draft DPA paragraph, Karthik to confirm operational impact by EOD tomorrow, then I’ll send a consolidated reply + DocuSign stub to Sara.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Manager, Customer Privacy 
Redwood Inference
Attachments: healthbridge_emergency_sop_v1.docx (docx), backup_timeline.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Sara Alvarez <sara@healthbridge.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Apr 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: carve-out for emergency restore + purge SOP

Soojin / Sara — I reviewed the draft SOP. High level I’m comfortable with the approach but recommend precise DPA language and two explicit guardrails:

1) Scope clause: carve-out applies only to customer-scoped backups that contain the requesting subject(s); an account-wide automatic snapshot retention is not permitted.
2) Access controls & auditability: every retrieval or purge action must trigger an immutable audit event (user id, timestamp, justification, ticket id). We will include an example log extract in the SOC2 evidence bundle.

Timeline suggestion (for procurement):
- Approval window: 3 business days for verification after request
- Purge run: within 7 calendar days after verification + key destruction verification

On EU transfers: we will not move EU snapshots out of EU except for a documented 24-hour transient process logged with an approved legal justification. That meets your constraint.

I’ll draft the DPA amendment paragraph and share by EOD tomorrow.

On the doc itself, two small asks Karthik: please confirm whether snapshots flagged "evidence_hold" will still be included in incremental deltas (we may need to exclude them to avoid surprise retention).

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Sara Alvarez <sara@healthbridge.io>
Date: Wed, 26 Apr 2028 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: carve-out for emergency restore + purge SOP

Thanks — a couple of technical notes:

• Snapshot delta behavior: by default our incremental snapshot pipeline would include "evidence_hold" snapshots in forward deltas unless we mark them as excluded. We should mark held snapshots as "no-propagate" so downstream incrementals do not carry dependent blocks. That avoids accidental reconstitution after purge.

• Storage locality: we can pin EU-scoped snapshots to the EU storage pool. For the 24-hour transient processing case, we will use encrypted TLS transit and rotate the envelope key immediately after transit; rotation events are written to the audit trail.

• Purge mechanics: our two-step approach is implementable — metadata strip + key shred. Note: key shred will make data irrecoverable, so we must coordinate the timing with legal/CS. Also suggest adding an automated notification hook to the HealthBridge ticket (webhook) to confirm purge completion.

Link to runbook here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HbrHealthbridgeSOP (internal access required).

I’ll also add a short playbook section describing rollback escape-hatch if we detect dependency blocks. No infra changes needed, but Ops will need a short run (1–2 hours) to test the process end-to-end before go-live.

—Karthik
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Sara Alvarez <sara@healthbridge.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request: carve-out for emergency restore + purge SOP

Sara — thank you for the context. Summary and next steps below: 

Agreed approach (summary):
- Soft-retention "evidence_hold" snapshots, max 90 days, EU snapshots pinned to EU pool.
- Two-step purge: metadata erase + envelope key shred; immutable audit log created for every action.
- Access restricted to named Ops role; retrieval requires documented justification & ticket.

Deliverables we will send by EOD Mon (30 Apr):
1) DPA amendment paragraph (Kimberly)
2) Finalized SOP and timeline (I’ll attach tested runbook)
3) DocuSign DPA stub for procurement (I’ll include the DocuSign link)
4) Ops test plan and confirmation of run (Karthik)

Attachments: healthbridge_emergency_sop_v1.docx (final draft), backup_timeline.xlsx
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/templates/0a1b2c3d (procurement stub)

Soojin
